description: This file defines the EmpContractDecorator class in the OrangeHRM project, which acts as a decorator around the EmpContract entity, providing methods to access formatted contract dates, retrieve contract attachments, and set employees by employee number. It utilizes traits for ORM assistance and date formatting, and interacts with the EmploymentContractService for additional functionalities.

classes.name: EmpContractDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the EmpContract entity, providing additional presentation and interaction methods related to employment contracts.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with an EmpContract entity.

methods.name: getEmploymentContractService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns an instance of EmploymentContractService.

methods.name: getStartDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted start date of the contract.

methods.name: getEndDate
methods.description: Returns the formatted end date of the contract.

methods.name: getContractAttachment
methods.description: Retrieves the contract attachment for the employee associated with the contract.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the Employee entity in the EmpContract based on the provided employee number.
